sources.title: ICAR Kharif Agro-Advisories for Farmers 2025
sources.claim: For Punjab rice, the advisory gives first-fortnight June nursery sowing for short and medium duration rice and first-fortnight July transplanting; it gives later windows for specified basmati varieties.

sources.title: Punjab Agricultural University wheat sowing advisory
sources.claim: The advisory reports the optimum Punjab wheat sowing window as 25 October to 15 November.

sources.title: India BRICS Agriculture Report, agricultural calendar section
sources.claim: The national calendar places kharif sowing in June-July and lists rice, maize, soybean, and cotton among kharif crops; it is context only and does not establish a Vidarbha district calendar.

sources.title: Cost of Cultivation and Production related data
sources.publisher: Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
sources.claim: This is the official index for cost-of-cultivation material. A per-quintal cost in the national statistics table is not substituted for the required district crop cost per hectare.
